_notes: What a friar is known for. E3 §8. Eleven portable reputations, 0..100, gated by stats: you cannot become known as a confessor with low Piety however many hours you sit in the box. Identities are mixes of two, and the province describes the man in one phrase. Effects on assignment fit are per work of a house (obedience.fitOf). Tunables invented.

reputations.label: Confessor
reputations.phrase: the one they line up for on Saturdays
reputations.line: Penitents travel to you. Other priests come to you. Eventually people who matter come to you, and you cannot tell anyone.

reputations.label: Preacher
reputations.line: Invitations from outside the province. The fastest route to becoming a figure.

reputations.label: Professor
reputations.line: Faculty appointments, doctoral students, academic networks, credibility in doctrinal disputes.

reputations.label: Spiritual director
reputations.phrase: the one the formators go to
reputations.line: You form the formators. Directees become a network of men who trust you completely, and whom you can never discuss.

reputations.label: Evangelist
reputations.line: Draws the unchurched and the curious. Vocations follow evangelists.

reputations.label: Liturgist
reputations.phrase: the one whose Office is sung
reputations.line: Beautiful worship draws people from outside the parish. Polarizing by nature.

reputations.label: Man of prayer
reputations.line: The reputation for holiness. Slows the decay of piety; the province protects such men, and elects them to nothing.

reputations.label: Builder
reputations.phrase: the one they send where things are broken
reputations.line: You get sent where things are broken. A blessing and a sentence.

reputations.label: Advocate
reputations.phrase: the one who speaks for the poor
reputations.line: Public standing, moral authority, and reliable political enemies.

reputations.label: Pastor of the dying
reputations.phrase: the one they call at two in the morning
reputations.line: The least glamorous reputation and the one laypeople never forget.

reputations.label: Confidant
reputations.phrase: the one the donors ask for
reputations.line: Money and access. Faintly suspect among the brothers.

identities.label: The one they line up for
identities.line: Massive lay draw, strong protection of piety, and a province that shields him from administrative assignments.

identities.label: The public intellectual
identities.line: National reach, media, invitations; Rome notices.

identities.label: The founder
identities.line: The strongest gate on founding a house.

identities.label: The reformer
identities.line: Influential and polarizing; the province splits over him.

identities.label: The formator
identities.line: Shapes a generation; his students fill the province in twenty years.

identities.label: The fixer
identities.line: Sent everywhere, trusted with everything, elected to nothing.

identities.label: The prophet
identities.line: Public power, and permanent friction with someone.
